prompt: A 72-year-old man is brought to the emergency department with confusion, fatigue, and severe thirst. He has a history of chronic kidney disease. His serum sodium is 156 mEq/L, and the team wants to lower it to 140 mEq/L. He weighs 70 kg. Using the Free Water Deficit in Hypernatremia calculator, what is his free water deficit in liters?

rubric_items.text: States that the estimated free water deficit is 4 L (exact match required; equivalent numerical notation such as 4.0 L is acceptable).
